Hammerspoon 1.1.1's MJAppDelegate.m does if (userMJConfigFile) MJConfigFile = userMJConfigFile, and stringForKey is non-nil for an empty string, so an empty value is its config path and it loads no config; the fix is a full path, or defaults delete org.hammerspoon.Hammerspoon MJConfigFile. vc agreed.
